name: PESI
one_liner: Nonprofit continuing education provider with courses for 40+ professional licenses across mental health, healthcare, and education.
short_description: PESI is a nonprofit continuing education provider offering seminars, webinars, and on-demand courses for mental health and healthcare professionals to maintain licensure.
long_description: PESI is one of the largest nonprofit continuing education providers for behavioral health and healthcare professionals. The platform offers CE credits through multiple formats: live in-person seminars, live webinars, on-demand digital courses, and multi-session certificate programs. PESI supports CE requirements for over 40 professional licenses including social workers (LCSW), marriage and family therapists (LMFT), professional counselors (LPC), psychologists, nurses, occupational therapists, physical therapists, and athletic trainers. Individual courses range from ~$50 to $600 depending on format and CE hours, with CE retreats priced around $800-1,300. PESI is known for bringing well-known presenters and covering cutting-edge clinical topics. The organization also offers free CE opportunities and bundle discounts. While pay-per-course pricing can add up quickly, PESI remains a trusted source for quality clinical training.
best_for: Mental health professionals needing CE credits for license renewal
Clinicians wanting flexible learning formats (live, on-demand, in-person)
Practitioners seeking certificate programs in specialized topics
not_for: Those wanting unlimited CE subscriptions (PESI is pay-per-course)

pricing.notes: Pay-per-course marketplace. Pricing varies significantly by format, CE hours, and topic. Bundles and free CE opportunities available. No unlimited subscription option.

compliance.notes: CE provider—does not handle patient data. Approved by state licensing boards and professional associations.
